name: What is an asset? (clip)
description: The starter clip record: what the recorder writes when it films the starter demonstration (no media shipped; the paths fill in after a recording). Shows the shape every generated clip has: source, media, recording facts, transcript and the auto-tagged keyword set.
author: AmberX AXF

transcript.say: Everything you see in an AmberX app is an asset.
Settings, then Appearance, is where the active asset of every type is picked.
Pick another asset in any slot and the app restyles itself at once.
Because the look comes from axHub, the same swap reaches every app.
